1531-1981-2415-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

5663-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5663-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

Activate Badgey by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

4050-4681-5170-7918.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1895-3330-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Leyline of Vitality trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-3330-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

670-1619-3504-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3504-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3504-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2180-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nearheath Stalker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2180-5256-6972.notes: If Nearheath Stalker starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

4365-4659-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.

57-3094-4742-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3094-4742-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

539-2092-4657.notablePrerequisites:
You control two creatures excluding Magus of the Candelabra that do not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.

Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and tapping it, untapping it and the two other creatures.
Repeat.

4605-5231-6132-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

628-5686-7194.description:

When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

104-2034-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

273-3168-7070.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
Urza's Incubator is naming one of the additional nontoken creature's types.
273-3168-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
Repeat.

620-2350-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-2350-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

1318-2534-5352.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1318-2534-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targeting Coercive Recruiter and a mana-producing permanent.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Doppelgang, targeting Coercive Recruiter and a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of Coercive Recruiter and the mana-producing permanent.
When the Coercive Recruiter tokens enter, they trigger, untapping Echo Mage and any other applicable permanent.
Holding priority, activate the two mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
1318-2534-5352.notes: If desired, you may only resolve one trigger in step 4. This would allow the next iteration to target any other permanent instead of Coercive Recruiter. You can then use the second trigger to untap Echo Mage again and proceed.

1479-5700-5701-5702-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-5702-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-2511-3499.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1329-3169-4050-6618.notablePrerequisites:

Cast Emry from the command zone by paying {U}.
When Emry enters the battlefield, it and both Genesis Chambers trigger.
Resolve the Emry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Choose to return Emry to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.

Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2198-2440-4055-4183.description:

Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Deceiver Exarch for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Energy Refractor twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

Repeat each turn until you have two or less opponents remaining.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dargo.

Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

Declare Aurelia as an attacker.

Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aurelia.
Surge to Victory triggers, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Aurelia and up to one other land, artifact and/or creature you control.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.

Pemmin's Aura attached to Blossom Dryad.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
391-3201-3525.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
